    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "The select-only combobox pattern: a button with role=\"combobox\" that controls a listbox; focus stays on the button while aria-activedescendant follows the highlight"
      - listitem: Options are role="option" with aria-selected; disabled ones carry aria-disabled and are skipped by the keys
      - listitem: The label names both the field and the list; hint and error are linked with aria-describedby, an error sets aria-invalid
      - listitem: The ring shows only under keyboard focus (:focus-visible), never after a click
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The list fades in out of a small lift from the field's edge – downward, or upward when it opens above
      - listitem: One soft highlight glides between the rows as the pointer or the arrow keys move; the chevron turns half a circle
      - listitem: The check on the chosen option draws itself
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Fills its container; a long choice ends in … with the full text on hover
      - listitem: The list opens where there is room – under the field, or above it near the bottom of the screen – and stays inside the window
      - listitem: It lives in the top layer (popover), so a card's overflow or z-index never cuts it
      - listitem: Touch screens get taller rows and 16px text; dark mode built in via .dark or data-theme="dark" on an ancestor
